raw_sections.summary:
Profile
SAP EWM Consultant having 4+ years of experience in SAP Consulting and Delivery on Application Maintenance Area. Client interaction, Understanding Business Requirement, Incident Management, Provide Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Actions. Worked in Retail Industrial Business Scenarios with Inbound & Outbound Delivery, Inventory Management.
raw_sections.experience:
Employment History
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING , Accenture
J U N E 2 0 2 1 — P R E S E N T
Responsible for driving functional discussion with client & third party and as a Functional Consultant provide solution design as per requirements.
As a part of application developments worked on different user stories/requirements for development such as Activation of Multi- picking process, Automation OD Creation, Custom Report to activate locked Handling units.
Worked on various standard processes in EWM i.e VAS , De consolidation etc . Also have quite a good experience in the Transportation Unit part .
Worked on different Business requirements and achieved by specific EWM Config. Change and developing some custom reports / technical code change.
Handled SAP EWM Integration with other Non-SAP Systems. ● As a part of Application Maintenance responsible for Incident Management & Service Requests handling, Resolving Priority Incidents and provide possible Root Cause Analysis.
Resolved Incidents related to Goods Issue, Goods Receipt, Reservation, Physical Inventory, Stock Transfer, Purchase Order, and other relevant objects in EWM.
Collaborate with various stakeholders to manage fit gap and scenarios analysis to understand the recurring incident (in Service Now) and propose solutions /changes. . Focused on Daily Order Processing Flow and reconciliation activities to avoid any Business Block.
Experienced in Integration testing (FIT, SIT, UAT) for EWM Business process.
